feed.title: DeepSeek Harness (dsh) Plugins — Curated List · Awesome DSH Plugin

entry.title: dgadelha1/dsh-explorer-plugin
entry.summary: Workspace file tree + Monaco editor: multiple tabs, undo/redo, live file watching (SSE), real VS Code TextMate syntax highlighting (28 languages) and Dark+/Light+ themes, embedded directly in the DSH web GUI.

entry.title: liznee/dsh-speech-input
entry.summary: A native microphone button in the composer: dictate drafts by voice, auto-stop after 5 s of silence, a capsule dictation UI with click-to-preview, supporting Chinese and English.

entry.title: liznee/dsh-file-resource
entry.summary: Local file input: images use the native path, while PDF/Office/EPUB/text are parsed locally into session-scoped resources, with a restricted read tool, @filename references, and a right-side split preview.

entry.title: dsh-product-subagent-console
entry.summary: A conversation-level multi-agent workbench for editable task plans, real child-session trees, plan-to-runtime comparison, and evidence-backed recovery previews.

entry.title: ianho7/dsh-port-inspector
entry.summary: Track the origin of local development ports on Windows and safely manage verified DSH services.

entry.title: YEYEYEYESHIFU/dsh-result-only-view
entry.summary: Results-only view toggle for the DSH Web GUI: folds thinking and tool-call process rows so conversations show only user messages and final replies; live summary chips for running steps, click-to-expand turn trace with hover-peek, auto/manual fold modes.

entry.title: maxmilian/dsh-grafana-query
entry.summary: Read-only Grafana tools over the data source proxy: instance health, data sources, instant and range PromQL queries, current alert state, and provisioned alert rules. npm `dsh-grafana-query`.

entry.title: maxmilian/dsh-odoo
entry.summary: Read-only Odoo tools over JSON-RPC: server info, model field introspection, and a restricted search_read on an allow list of models. A draft-create tool is registered only when allowWrite is enabled. npm `dsh-odoo`.

entry.title: maxmilian/dsh-sentry
entry.summary: Read-only Sentry tools: project listing, issue search and detail, and the latest or a specific event with a trimmed stacktrace that drops local variables, request data, and secret-looking tags. npm `dsh-sentry`.

entry.title: pauloapoloni/dsh-pr-checks
entry.summary: Status and progress of GitHub Actions checks for the open pull requests, grouped by workspace/project, in the sidebar footer.

entry.title: SiriLee/dsh-approval-hotkeys
entry.summary: Approval-panel keyboard shortcuts: Enter approves once, Esc rejects, Esc pauses the keyboard-driven review; works across approval and ask panels.

entry.title: SiriLee/dsh-rewind
entry.summary: In-window in-place rewind (Claude Code /rewind semantics): a ↶ button beside each user message truncates the model context back to any message, with optional Claude Code-style file rollback (disk-persisted before backups).

entry.title: maxmilian/dsh-forge
entry.summary: Read-only Gitea and Forgejo tools over the REST API both projects share: repositories, issue and pull request search, PR diffs and changed files, and Actions runs, jobs and job logs. npm `@maxhsu/dsh-forge`.

entry.title: SiriLee/dsh-edit-approval
entry.summary: Per-change approval gate before file writes and tool calls: write/edit/stream operations show red/green line-level diffs before release, with bash command approval (off by default) and configurable gating.

entry.title: tsingshitao-nuke/dsh-set-workspace
entry.summary: Right-click a folder in Windows File Explorer to open it as a DSH workspace: registers the folder, launches DSH if needed, and switches the page to it.

entry.title: maxmilian/dsh-sonarqube
entry.summary: Read-only SonarQube Community Build tools: instance status, Quality Gate for a branch or pull request, issue and Security Hotspot search, and coverage, duplication or caller-selected measures. npm `dsh-sonarqube`.

entry.title: YEYEYEYESHIFU/dsh-session-hotkeys
entry.summary: Keyboard session management for the DSH Web GUI: switch sessions like browser tabs (positional Alt+1-9, pinned slots, previous/next), keyboard model switching, alternate send, archive confirmation, and focus-search, with every binding rebindable via Windows/macOS presets.

entry.title: Laplace-bit/dsh-pianist
entry.summary: AI piano performance: ask the agent to play a piece on a Canvas2D grand piano with real Salamander Grand samples and a playable 88-key keyboard.

entry.title: dsh-blue/blue
entry.summary: An interactive full-screen terminal UI for DeepSeek Harness: streaming Markdown transcripts, tool-call cards, an approval panel, session management, and hot theme switching — every component is a hot-pluggable plugin tree.

entry.title: FuqiangCraft/dsh-desktop
entry.summary: Adds desktop notifications, a multi-agent visualization canvas, and an optional screen-capture tool to DSH.

entry.title: qwert702/dsh-auto-translate
entry.summary: Auto-translates English replies inline below the original text, with Chinese annotations for tool calls; translation goes through an independent provider request and never enters the session context.

entry.title: qwert702/dsh-commander
entry.summary: Commander mode for DSH Web: inject protocol briefs into the session title bar, parse task blocks from model replies and auto-execute them, separating strategy from execution; activated via a badge button.

entry.title: qwert702/dsh-token-viewer
entry.summary: CC Switch-style token consumption statistics: per-request usage log, real-consumption hero with cache-hit rate, trend chart, per-model peak/off-peak pricing, per-project stats, and account balance.

entry.title: stephenlzc/dsh-swarm-panel#dsh-swarm-plugin
entry.summary: Conversation Flow observability for DeepSeek Harness swarms, with topology, routed-message inspection, HITL pauses, Live follow, and child-session navigation.

entry.title: taxueseek/dsh-files
entry.summary: File upload with color-coded attachment cards (session-isolated storage, sha256 dedup, TTL sweep) plus a content-sniffing read_document tool for PDF/DOCX/XLSX/TXT.

entry.title: imkelt/DSH-RAG
entry.summary: Local knowledge bases for DSH Web with multi-directory incremental indexing, BM25 and SiliconFlow hybrid retrieval, and source cards that locate and open original files.

entry.title: qwert702/dsh-context-compressor
entry.summary: Context compression for small models: compresses tool output and conversation history to a few sentences, freeing context for the actual task; continues in a fresh session automatically.

entry.title: qwert702/dsh-continue-on-limit
entry.summary: Auto-sends continue when a local model hits its output-token cap: dual-source detection (turn-max-tokens node + provider response), maxConsecutive guard (default 3) prevents infinite loops.

entry.title: qwert702/dsh-memory
entry.summary: Project-level and global long-term memory for DSH Web: isolated POST /items route to avoid path conflicts, multi-turn tool-call context compression before storing entries, deduplication and session-persistent storage.

entry.title: zilliztech/memsearch
entry.summary: Shared Markdown memory for DSH and other coding agents, with automatic capture, pre-step context injection, searchable recall, and a review panel.
